title: Encoded gate evaluation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $R$ and $G$ be finite bit strings, and let $P$ be a finite list of finite bit strings. The gate-running procedure applied to the encoding of the context determined by $n$, $R$, and $P$, paired with $G$, returns the encoding of that context together with the word and list of values obtained by applying the abstract evaluation step $|G|$ times, starting from $(G,[])$, using modulus $ itsVal(R)+1$ and assigning the $i$th input variable the value $ itsVal(P_i)+1$ (with an empty word when $i$ is outside the list).
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite list of finite bit strings
